Daily active users spiked to 427 on 22 Oct 2024 (expected 313, robust z 4.3); main driver: platform = android (80% of the deviation). Window 2024-10-21 to 2024-10-22, 2 day(s) flagged, severity medium (known event: Festive campaign 2024 (Diwali)).

Daily active users spiked to 483 on 28 Oct 2024 (expected 309, robust z 6.6); main driver: platform = android (81% of the deviation). Window 2024-10-28 to 2024-11-12, 14 day(s) flagged, severity high (known event: Festive campaign 2024 (Diwali)).

Tracked / backend KYC completions dropped to 33.9% on 13 May 2025 (expected 100.0%, robust z -13.2); main driver: platform (untracked completions) = android (100% of the deviation). Window 2025-05-12 to 2025-05-29, 14 day(s) flagged, severity high (known event: App release 5.2.0 (hotfix 5.2.1 on 16 May)).

Support tickets spiked to 32 on 14 Aug 2025 (expected 6, robust z 6.7); main driver: ticket category = payment_failure (82% of the deviation). Window 2025-08-14 to 2025-08-14, 1 day(s) flagged, severity medium (no known business event - investigate).

EMI payment failure rate spiked to 47.1% on 15 Aug 2025 (expected 8.9%, robust z 15.6); main driver: failure reason (excess failed debits) = gateway_timeout (96% of the deviation). Window 2025-08-14 to 2025-08-15, 2 day(s) flagged, severity high (no known business event - investigate).

Signups spiked to 222 on 15 Sep 2025 (expected 113, robust z 6.8); main driver: acquisition channel = affiliate (87% of the deviation). Window 2025-09-08 to 2025-09-21, 14 day(s) flagged, severity high (no known business event - investigate).

Daily active users spiked to 920 on 16 Sep 2025 (expected 692, robust z 5.8); main driver: platform = android (94% of the deviation). Window 2025-09-13 to 2025-09-20, 6 day(s) flagged, severity high (no known business event - investigate).

Applications submitted spiked to 94 on 18 Sep 2025 (expected 46, robust z 4.7); main driver: acquisition channel = affiliate (69% of the deviation). Window 2025-09-17 to 2025-09-18, 2 day(s) flagged, severity medium (no known business event - investigate).

EXP-ONB-2026-01 (onboarding redesign, 2026-01-12 to 2026-02-22 (6 weeks)): 7-day KYC completion 61.78% treatment vs 58.51% control, difference +3.26 pp (95% CI +0.54 to +5.99 pp), relative uplift +5.6%, p-value 0.0191; P(treatment better) 99.0%.
EXP-ONB-2026-01 design: 2,365 users per arm required for a 4.0 pp MDE; realised 2,543 control / 2,407 treatment; sample-ratio check p-value 0.053 (no SRM).
EXP-ONB-2026-01 guardrails: approval rate +3.13 pp (pass), FPD30 -1.48 pp (pass), KYC support tickets +0.16 pp (inconclusive). Decision: SHIP with post-launch monitoring of kyc_support_ticket_rate.
EXP-ONB-2026-01 estimated impact at the post-launch run rate: about 1,502 additional verified customers and 387 additional first loans per year, worth about ₹16.59 L net revenue from first loans.
EXP-RPY-2025-11 (Autopay nudge at disbursal): autopay 64.28% treatment vs 46.62% control, difference +17.65 pp (95% CI +12.76 to +22.54 pp), p-value 0.0000. Decision: SHIP.

EXP-PRC-2025-06 (Upfront fee transparency on the offer screen): accepted 90.98% treatment vs 88.78% control, difference +2.20 pp (95% CI -1.93 to +6.32 pp), p-value 0.2974. Decision: INCONCLUSIVE - underpowered: needed 1,530 users per arm for a 3.0 pp MDE, had 410.

Onboarding funnel (cohorts at least 30 days old): 76,944 signups, 58.95% completed KYC, 36.80% submitted an application, 17.40% received a loan; the largest single loss is signup to KYC completion (31,589 customers).
7-day KYC completion by platform: web 43.94%, Android 57.78%, iOS 60.94%; web trails iOS by 17.01 pp.

First-loan FPD30 for loans disbursed in the Oct-Nov 2025 festive season vs Jun-Sep 2025: affiliate 4.49% vs 1.71%, paid social 5.42% vs 3.67%, partnerships 2.40% vs 3.25%.
Borrowers with autopay pay 86.99% of instalments on time vs 79.89% without (correlation, not causation); 62.82% of borrowers have used autopay.
